summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ProShares UltraShort SmallCap600 (SDD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Small Cap 600 index. The fund provides daily -2x exposure to a market-cap-weighted index of 600 US small-cap companies. SDD was launched on Jan 23, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
